# Updated Use Cases

| ID: UC1 | Name: Upload Assessment Data |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | Educational therapist uploads student assessment and screening data. |
| **Actor: Primary** | Educational therapist |
| **Actor: Secondary** | \- |
| **Trigger** | Educational therapist clicks on the “Upload Data” button. |
| **Precondition** | Educational therapist is logged into the platform. |
| **Postcondition** | Student’s assessment data is successfully saved into the database. |
| **Error States** | Student’s assessment data fails to be saved into the database. |
| **Operational Flow** | 1 \- System prompts the educational therapist to upload student assessment and screening data. 2 \- Educational therapist fills in the required fields and uploads the assessment report as a file. 3 \- System parses the assessment report and stores it in the assessment database. 4 \- Database server sends a positive response to the system once the assessment and screening data has been saved successfully. 5 \- System displays a message to the educational therapist to show that the data has been saved successfully. |
| **Alternative Flows** | 2a \- File uploaded by educational therapist is of invalid format; System rejects it and prompts re-upload 3a \- Parser cannot locate one or more required assessment fields (e.g. learner ID, assessment date, sub-test scores) in the uploaded report; System aborts the store and displays a parse error naming the missing field(s). 4a \- Assessment database server sends a negative response to the system. 5a \- System displays an error message to the educational therapist. |

| ID: UC2 | Name: Generate Learner Profile |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | The system consolidates the learner's assessment and screening records and processes them through a profiling algorithm to generate an interpretable, visual profile. |
| **Actor: Primary** | Educational therapist |
| **Actor: Secondary** | \- |
| **Trigger** | The Educator selects a specific learner from the web application's analytics dashboard and clicks the "Generate Profile" button. |
| **Precondition** | Educational therapist is logged in. |
| **Postcondition** | Learner profile is successfully generated, visualised and stored. |
| **Error States** | Learner data or record cannot be retrieved/does not exist in the database (Therefore, no profile visualisation could be generated). |
| **Operational Flow** | 1 \- System receives the generate-profile request for the selected learner. 2 \- Learner’s assessment and screening data is retrieved from the database. 3 \- System runs profiling algorithm over retrieved data 4 \- Profiling algorithm identifies patterns across literacy, phonological awareness, comprehension, and working memory indicators. 5 \- System generates interpretable learner profile visualisations. 6 \- Database server sends a positive response to the system once learner profile is successfully saved into the learner profile database. 7 \- System displays a message to the educational therapist to show that the learner profile data has been saved successfully. *Note: Profiling algorithm is an internal system component, not an actor.* |
| **Alternative Flows** | 2a \- Learner record set is empty \-\> System aborts profile generation.  4a \- Profiling algorithm returns no valid patterns 5a \- Visualisation fails because a required profile dimension is null from profiling algorithm. 6a \- Database server sends a negative response to the system. (Profile not saved)  7a \- System displays an error message to the educational therapist. |

| ID: UC3 | Name: Generate Adaptive Learning Activity |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | Generate a differentiated learning activity for a learner profile by retrieving curriculum context, prompting the model, and validating the output against a review framework. |
| **Actor: Primary** | Educational Therapist |
| **Actor: Secondary** | LLM API |
| **Trigger** | Educational Therapist requests an activity and feeds the existing Student profile |
| **Precondition** | Educational Therapist has logged in to the platform; a learner profile exists |
| **Postcondition** | Adaptive Learning Activity generated, internally reviewed and added to the database |
| **Error States** | Activity is not successfully generated/validated |
| **Operational Flow** | 1 \- Educational Therapist requests generation of an Adaptive Learning Activity 2 \- System prompts therapist to enter/select student profile, to create a custom activity based on the students 3 \- (include UC5) System retrieves the relevant profile and “gold-standard” activities/strategies from knowledge base 4 \- System fuses these retrievals with initial request parameters to form a comprehensive prompt for the generative Agent 5 \- System sends prompt to LLM API (Generative Agent), which returns a customised activity 6 \- System passes activity to Validative Agent, which checks it against the review framework 7 \- Once validated, the system stores activity and displays to therapists for view/use. *Note: Generative and Validative Agents are internal components of the system* |
| **Alternative Flows** | 6a \- Validative Agent rejects the Activity generated; System reprompts the Generative Agent with feedback; System repeats steps 5-6 until approved \-\> continue at step 7 6b \- Maximum retries reached; System surfaces best attempt and flags it for therapist review |

| ID: UC4 | Name: Review Learning Activity |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Description** | Therapist leaves a review for the learning activity in the app |
| **Actor: Primary** | Therapist |
| **Actor: Secondary** | \- |
| **Trigger** | Therapist clicks on “Leave a review” button  |
| **Precondition** | Therapist has already generated a learning activity  |
| **Postcondition** | The review is stored and displayed in the app |
| **Error States** | Review is not submitted/stored |
| **Operational Flow** | 1 \- Therapist types out their review for the generated learning activity 2 \- Therapist clicks on upload  3 \- System sends the review to the database server  4 \- Database server validates and sends a positive response to the system  5 \- The review is stored in the database server  6 \- The therapist’s review is displayed on the app  |
| **Alternative Flows** | 4a \- The database server sends a negative response to the system 5a \- The review cannot be stored to the database server; System displays an error |

| ID: UC5 ( UC3 \<\<includes\>\> UC5) | Name: Retrieve Instructional Strategy |
| :---- | :---- |
| Description | Retrieving instructional strategy using Retrieval Augmented Generation from a structured knowledge base via RAG. |
| Actor: Primary | Educational therapist |
| Actor: Secondary | \- |
| Trigger | UC3 reaches retrieval step (System-initiated) |
| Precondition | The knowledge base is available and active session exists |
| Postcondition | Relevant instructional strategies returned to therapist |
| Error States | Knowledge-base data is out of date or unretrievable |
| Operational Flow | 1 \- The System extracts the target student's profile metrics (e.g., specific cognitive deficits, reading levels) from the Student Database. 2 \- The System formulates a targeted search query based on these parameters and sends it to the LLM API. 3 \- System queries the Database Server to retrieve existing, contextually relevant instructional strategies and pedagogical frameworks. 4 \- System formats the retrieved documents into a structured, readable summary without altering the underlying pedagogical methods. 5 \- The System returns the strategies to UC3 |
| Alternative Flows | 3a \- Retrieved context in the database is insufficient 4a \- System determines that insufficient knowledge is present to generate a strategy; System halts retrieval 5a \- System alerts therapist of the issue, suggests generalised best-practice interventions |

| **Alternative Flows** | 2a \-  No learners are assigned to the therapist; the system displays an empty-state message prompting the therapist to add a learner. 3a \- Database server returns an error (connection failure or query timeout); System displays a retrieval error and offers a retry. 4a \-  System fails to render the list; Therapist remains on the dashboard with an error message.  |

# Summary of Discussion Since Project Meeting 1

Since Project Meeting 1, the team received two communications from the client (DAS, Ms Soofrina Mubarak). Both concerned data and resource provisioning for Subsystems 2 and 3\.

1\. Release of teaching materials and reference tools

The client shared the DAS MLP teaching materials for all three band levels, along with supporting curriculum documents and two sandboxed reference tools.

Band structure clarified:

| Band | Target Level |
| :---- | :---- |
| Band A(A1/A2/A3) | Primary School |
| Band B | Both Primary and Secondary |
| Band C | Secondary |

Supporting documents provided:

- Teaching scope and sequence, which defines the intended flow of the phonics lessons.  
- Curriculum matrix, which maps the focus of each curriculum component across band levels.

Reference tools provided:

- DAS MLP Curriculum Crafter, a custom GPT aligned to DAS curriculum and teaching practices, usable for trial lesson generation.  
- DAS ELL Report Writer, a custom GPT that drafts therapist reports from structured inputs, aligned to DAS MLP report conventions.

Implications for our design:

- The curriculum matrix and scope and sequence give us an authoritative taxonomy for the skill dimensions in the Cognitive Profiling System, and a basis for tagging generated activities to the correct band and component. These replace the placeholder skill categories assumed at Meeting 1\.  
- The band structure confirms that generated activities must be band-aware, which we have reflected in our retrieval and generation flow. Our initial corpus remains Band A.  
- The two sandboxed GPTs serve as baselines. They indicate the output style and coverage the client expects, and give us a reference point for evaluating our own generation quality rather than defining it ourselves.  
- All materials are confidential and restricted to this working group, so they will not be committed to any public repository. Storage and access handling have been noted as a project constraint.

2\. Offer of Student Writing Samples

The client offered three categories of student writing samples and asked the team to nominate a preferred type, which would then be extracted in bulk.

| Sample Type | Description | Ground Truth Provided |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Edit & Diagram 1 | Simple Sentences | Answer Key Included |
| Edit & Diagram 3 | Longer Sentences | Answer Format included, but free response |
| Narrative Writing | Long Essays | Marking Rubric Included |

These samples are the primary input evidence for the Cognitive Profiling System. The choice involves a trade-off:

* Edit & Diagram 1 has a fixed answer key, so learner errors can be tagged deterministically and profiling accuracy can be measured against a known ground truth. This makes it the strongest candidate for our initial pipeline and for unit and integration testing.  
* Edit & Diagram 3 and Narrative Writing yield richer error signals but require rubric-based or LLM-assisted scoring, which introduces evaluation ambiguity and would require a validation loop before results could be trusted.

Team position: We intend to request Edit & Diagram 1 first as the primary corpus, since a fixed answer key lets us validate the profiling output objectively, with Edit & Diagram 3 as a secondary corpus once the deterministic pipeline is stable.

#### 3\. Outstanding items

* Confirm the preferred writing sample type with the client so bulk extraction can begin.  
* Confirm how the curriculum matrix components should map to our cognitive profile skill dimensions.

## Solution Class Diagram {#solution-class-diagram}

| @startuml DAS\_DIAL\_Class\_Diagramtitle DAS D.I.A.L Solution Class Diagram (Subsystems 2 & 3\)skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0skinparam packageStyle rectangleleft to right direction' \===================== BOUNDARY (React) \=====================package "View (React \+ Tailwind)" {class Dashboard {\+requestLearnerList()\+requestProfile(learnerId : UUID)\+requestActivity(profileId : UUID, params : GenerationParams)\+requestReview(activityId: UUID)\+submitReview(activityId : UUID, text : String)\+shareActivity(activityId : UUID, recipientEmail : String)\+showLearnerList(learners : List\<Learner\>)\+showProfile(profile : LearnerProfile)\+showActivity(activity : LearningActivity)\+showReview(review: Review)}class AuthView {\+submitLogin(email : String, password : String)\+submitSignUp(email : String, password : String)}class UploadView {\+submitAssessmentFile(learnerId, file)}}' \===================== CONTROLLER (FastAPI) \=====================' Services are injected via Depends() \-\> they are METHOD PARAMETERS,' not attributes. Hence Controller ..\> Service is a USES-A dependency.package "Controller (FastAPI routers)" {class AuthController {\+signUp(email, password, svc : AuthService) : Session\+logIn(email, password, svc : AuthService) : Session}class AssessmentController {\+uploadAssessment(learnerId, file, svc : AssessmentService) : Result}class ProfileController {\+generateProfile(learnerId, svc : ProfilingService) : LearnerProfile}class ActivityController {\+generateActivity(profileId, params, svc : ActivityGenerationService) : LearningActivity}class LearnerController {\+listLearners(svc : LearnerService) : List\<Learner\>}class ReviewController {\+submitReview(activityId, text, svc : ReviewService) : Review}class ShareController {\+shareActivity(activityId, recipientEmail, svc : ShareService) : Result}}' \===================== SERVICE \=====================' Repositories / gateways are constructor-injected and stored on self' \-\> they are ATTRIBUTES \-\> HAS-A (solid, with multiplicity).package "Service (application logic)" {class AuthService {\-userRepo : UserRepository\-authGateway : AuthGateway\+register(email, password) : Therapist\+authenticate(email, password) : Session}class AssessmentService {\-assessmentRepo : AssessmentRepository\+parseAndStore(learnerId, file) : AssessmentRecord}class LearnerService {\-learnerRepo : LearnerRepository\+listLearners() : List\<Learner\>}class ProfilingService {\-assessmentRepo : AssessmentRepository\-profileRepo : LearnerProfileRepository\-algorithm : ProfilingAlgorithm\+generateProfile(learnerId) : LearnerProfile}class ActivityGenerationService {\-profileRepo : LearnerProfileRepository\-activityRepo : ActivityRepository\-retrieval : RetrievalService\-graph : ActivityGraph\+generate(profileId, params) : LearningActivity\-buildPrompt(profile, strategies, params) : Prompt}class RetrievalService {\-kbRepo : KnowledgeBaseRepository\-llm : LLMApiClient\+retrieveStrategies(profileMetrics) : InstructionalStrategy\[\]}class ReviewService {\-reviewRepo : ReviewRepository\+submitReview(activityId, therapistId, text) : Review}class ShareService {\-activityRepo : ActivityRepository\-emailGateway : EmailGateway\+share(activityId, recipientEmail) : Result\-renderPdf(activity) : PDF}}' \===================== AGENT / ALGORITHM (internal AI) \=====================package "Agent / Algorithm (LangChain \+ LangGraph)" {class ProfilingAlgorithm {\+analyse(records) : ProfileMetrics\+cluster(records) : Cluster\[\]}class ActivityGraph {\-maxRetries : int\-retryCount : int\-generator : GenerativeAgent\-validator : ValidativeAgent\+run(prompt) : LearningActivity}class GenerativeAgent {\-llm : LLMApiClient\+generate(prompt) : LearningActivity}class ValidativeAgent {\-llm : LLMApiClient\+validate(activity, framework) : ValidationResult}}' \===================== GATEWAY (external services) \=====================package "Gateway (external services)" {class AuthGateway {\+verify(email, password) : AuthResponse\+createUser(email, password) : AuthResponse}class LLMApiClient {\+complete(prompt) : string\+embed(text) : Vector}class EmailGateway {\+send(pdf : PDF, recipientEmail : string) : SendResult}}' \===================== REPOSITORY (Supabase) \=====================package "Repository (Supabase \+ pgvector)" {class UserRepository {\-db : SupabaseClient\+save(therapist) : Therapist\+findByEmail(email) : Therapist}class LearnerRepository {\-db : SupabaseClient\+save(learner) : bool\+findById(learnerId) : Learner}class AssessmentRepository {\-db : SupabaseClient\+save(record) : bool\+findByLearner(learnerId) : AssessmentRecord\[\]}class LearnerProfileRepository {\-db : SupabaseClient\+save(profile) : bool\+findByLearner(learnerId) : LearnerProfile}class ActivityRepository {\-db : SupabaseClient\+save(activity) : bool\+findById(activityId) : LearningActivity}class ReviewRepository {\-db : SupabaseClient\+save(review) : bool\+findByActivity(activityId) : Review\[\]}class KnowledgeBaseRepository {\-db : SupabaseClient\+similaritySearch(queryVector, k) : InstructionalStrategy\[\]}}' \===================== ENTITY (Pydantic) \=====================package "Entity (domain models)" {class Therapist {\+id : UUID\+email : string\+authUserId : UUID\+name : string}class Session {\+token : string\+therapistId : UUID\+expiresAt : datetime}class Learner {\+id : UUID\+pseudonym : string\+bandLevel : string\+tier : string}class AssessmentRecord {\+id : UUID\+learnerId : UUID\+assessmentDate : date\+riskScore : float\+taskResults : json\+strengths : string\[\]\+weaknesses : string\[\]\+confidenceScore : float}class LearnerProfile {\+id : UUID\+learnerId : UUID\+phonologicalProcessing : float\+decoding : float\+spelling : float\+comprehension : float\+workingMemory : float\+executiveFunctioning : float\+visualisation : json\+createdAt : datetime}class LearningActivity {\+id : UUID\+profileId : UUID\+content : json\+literacyObjective : string\+level : string\+status : ActivityStatus\+groundedOn : InstructionalStrategy\[\]\+createdAt : datetime}class InstructionalStrategy {\+id : UUID\+content : string\+source : string\+tags : string\[\]}class Review {\+id : UUID\+activityId : UUID\+therapistId : UUID\+text : string\+createdAt : datetime}enum ActivityStatus {GENERATEDVALIDATEDFLAGGED}}' \=====================================================================' USES-A (dashed, NO multiplicity) \- temporary use / method parameter' \=====================================================================AuthView ..\> AuthControllerUploadView ..\> AssessmentControllerDashboard ..\> ProfileControllerDashboard ..\> ActivityControllerDashboard ..\> ReviewControllerDashboard ..\> ShareControllerDashboard ..\> LearnerControllerAuthController ..\> AuthServiceAssessmentController ..\> AssessmentServiceProfileController ..\> ProfilingServiceActivityController ..\> ActivityGenerationServiceReviewController ..\> ReviewServiceShareController ..\> ShareServiceLearnerController ..\> LearnerService' Repositories RETURN entities \- not stored as attributesUserRepository ..\> TherapistLearnerRepository ..\> LearnerAssessmentRepository ..\> AssessmentRecordLearnerProfileRepository ..\> LearnerProfileActivityRepository ..\> LearningActivityReviewRepository ..\> ReviewKnowledgeBaseRepository ..\> InstructionalStrategyLearningActivity ..\> ActivityStatus' \=====================================================================' HAS-A (solid, WITH multiplicity) \- stored as attribute' \=====================================================================AuthService "1" \--\> "1" AuthGateway : has \>AuthService "1" \--\> "1" UserRepository : has \>AssessmentService "1" \--\> "1" AssessmentRepository : has \>ProfilingService "1" \--\> "1" AssessmentRepository : has \>ProfilingService "1" \--\> "1" LearnerProfileRepository : has \>ActivityGenerationService "1" \--\> "1" LearnerProfileRepository : has \>ActivityGenerationService "1" \--\> "1" ActivityRepository : has \>ActivityGenerationService "1" \--\> "1" RetrievalService : has \>RetrievalService "1" \--\> "1" KnowledgeBaseRepository : has \>RetrievalService "1" \--\> "1" LLMApiClient : has \>GenerativeAgent "1" \--\> "1" LLMApiClient : has \>ValidativeAgent "1" \--\> "1" LLMApiClient : has \>ReviewService "1" \--\> "1" ReviewRepository : has \>ShareService "1" \--\> "1" ActivityRepository : has \>ShareService "1" \--\> "1" EmailGateway : has \>LearnerService "1" \--\> "1" LearnerRepository : has \>' \=====================================================================' COMPOSITION (filled diamond) \- exclusive part, dies with the whole' \=====================================================================ProfilingService "1" \*-- "1" ProfilingAlgorithmActivityGenerationService "1" \*-- "1" ActivityGraphActivityGraph "1" \*-- "1" GenerativeAgentActivityGraph "1" \*-- "1" ValidativeAgent' \=====================================================================' ENTITY ASSOCIATIONS (solid, WITH multiplicity)' | @startuml UC9\_View\_Learner\_Listtitle UC9 \- View Learner Listactor "Educational Therapist" as Tparticipant "Dashboard\\n(React)" as UIparticipant LearnerController as Ctrlparticipant LearnerService as Svcdatabase LearnerRepository as RepoT \-\> UI : open dashboard / click "Learners"UI \-\> Ctrl : listLearners()Ctrl \-\> Ctrl : resolve therapistId from sessionCtrl \-\> Svc : listLearners(therapistId)Svc \-\> Repo : findByTherapist(therapistId)alt DB positive response    alt learners found        Repo \--\> Svc : Learner\[\]        Svc \--\> Ctrl : List\<Learner\>        Ctrl \--\> UI : List\<Learner\>        UI \--\> T : render learner list (pseudonym, band, tier)    else no learners assigned        Repo \--\> Svc : \[\]        Svc \--\> Ctrl : List\<Learner\> (empty)        Ctrl \--\> UI : empty list        UI \--\> T : "No learners assigned" empty state    endelse DB negative response    Repo \--\> Svc : error    Svc \--\> Ctrl : StorageError    Ctrl \--\> UI : error message    UI \--\> T : "Could not load learners", offer retryend@enduml |
